probes.label: owner
probes.why: The direct cleanup or effect runs ownerless versus inside a live root; dispose is queued outside render.

probes.label: leaf
probes.why: A present owner-backed onSettled leaf forbids the memo/effect or onCleanup; ordinary component construction accepts it.

probes.label: data-first
probes.why: Supplied data accessor first executes under the created tracked effect. Correct moves sink write to click.

probes.label: data-flush
probes.why: Change source after construction; data compute invokes it again tracked. First callback is clean; only recomputation attempts owned write.
